[Product owner] Which project defaults (flags) should the view list?

❯ 1. Every switch
     All 15 switches, default or not
  2. Non-default + Show all
     Only what differs, with a Show all toggle
  3. Non-default only
     Only what differs from the shipped default
  4. Type something.
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  5. Chat about this
